description.value: Papa John's is a national pizza chain franchise located in a strip-mall unit in Langley, BC, offering takeout pizza. Touring cyclists passing through the area can pick up a ready-made or custom pizza order by phone or in person. No drive-through is available, making it a walk-in or call-ahead stop.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: bollard (6 spaces) at 30m; bollard (4 spaces) at 49m; bollard (4 spaces) at 61m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record provides core details: fast_food/pizza, takeaway=yes, drive_through=no, and a phone number. The website (papajohns.com) is the corporate homepage and all subpages return a 'Technical Difficulties' error for online ordering — no location-specific content is available to confirm amenities, address, or phone. Amenity claims rely solely on OSM tags; all unconfirmed fields default to null.
